text:
olivia: Heads-up: nightly prober flagged a throughput regression on h100 for midseq (512-1024) on model-x. ~15% token/sec drop. logs + microbench attached in CI.

ci-bot: Nightly sweep run=nightly-autotune-2135550000
Summary: regressions detected for model-x@v2 on h100 (seq 512-1024)
Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/runs/2135550000/logs
Microbench CSV: https://ci.redwood/runs/2135550000/microbench.csv

mat: can you paste the failing microbench lines (lat, kernel id)?

sana: seeing the same trend on ampere when KV cache is enabled and batch>=8. looks like batching heuristic flips the kernel path.

ci-bot: microbench excerpt:
```
seq=512,batch=4,kernel_id=matmul_v2_shard,lat=0.87ms
seq=512,batch=8,kernel_id=matmul_v1_legacy,lat=1.02ms  <- ~17% slower
```
heuristic note: current rule prefers v1 when batch>=8 for memory-safety fallback

noah: that batch-only rule was added for fp16 stability. sounds like we need to make it seq-aware too.

olivia: Proposed action list: 1) add a focused repro microbench to perf-ci covering seq=256/512/1024 with KV on; 2) tighten heuristic to consider seqlen before falling back; 3) run perf-lab repro on h100 and ampere.

mat: I'll open a quick PR to change heuristic: prefer v1 only when (seq > 2048) || (batch > 16) || (kv_enabled == false). keeping it conservative but avoids midseq regresses.

sana: immediate mitigation: pin model-x route to kernel=matmul_v2 on Dedicated until we verify. I'll request pin in routing config.

noah: also adding a regression alert: if throughput delta >10% for same model+arch+seq bucket, fire a pager to perf-oncall (or at least a slack alert).

olivia: assigning: mat -> PR, sana -> routing pin, noah -> alert rule. I'll run repro in perf-lab and paste numbers.

olivia: repro complete on perf-lab h100: matmul_v2 restores baseline throughput, attached diff/plot: https://ci.redwood/runs/2135550150/repro.png :thumbsup:

mat: merged hotfix to heuristic on staging. will run smoke and roll to prod if green.

ci-bot: scheduled next nightly sweep at 2026-03-17 03:00 UTC (2135636400).

olivia: leaving a short note for release notes and postmortem if this persists.

sana: thanks — will update the KV+batching test matrix in the autotune harness to include batch 1/4/8/16 x seq 128/256/512/1024.

mat: thanks all, feel free to ping me if you want the quickbench command:
```
./microbench --model model-x --seq 512 --batch 8 --kv on --arch h100 --repeat 20
```

noah: once we have perf-ci coverage for this bucket, we should catch regressions before they reach nightly run.

olivia: resolved for now, tracking follow-ups in the kernel-autotune board.
